analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (30,185 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (31,431/31,814/34,574 KRW): Below short-term and mid-term moving averages, confirming a weak trend position.
· Significant drop vs SMA100/200 (37,791/36,349 KRW): Continued weakening of the mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (33.7%): Current price level is high relative to the 52-week low but low relative to the high.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (38.9→43.2): Exited oversold territory but remains in the neutral zone below 50, indicating weak upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-542.8670→192.3193): Improving in negative territory but bearish convergence continues, no trend reversal signal confirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band 31,814 KRW): Price is sideways around the middle band, with band width at 44.65% indicating reduced volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (29,960 KRW): Close to the 5-day low (29,820 KRW), potentially acting as psychological support.
· Swing resistance (30,570 KRW): Short-term resistance zone, potential for upward reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low patterns: 5-day high 33,675 KRW, 20-day high 40,585 KRW; 5-day low 29,820 KRW, 20-day low 27,045 KRW: No clear Higher Low or Lower High pattern formed, indicating a sideways phase.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.44): Significantly subdued compared to the 5-day average, indicating low confidence in current price movements.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): Lack of directional bias due to short-term moving average downtrend and subdued volume, maintaining a wait-and-see approach and requiring confirmation of breakout above support (29,960 KRW) or resistance (30,570 KRW).
